split_policy: Frozen session plan, identical across algorithms and domains; all four recordings stay together
training_cv: 3-fold stratified session CV on train only; fixed seed 20261021; all imputation/scaling/search inside folds
rare_class_policy: Reduce folds to minimum observed class count if 2; if any observed class has <2 train cases, no stratified search and use predeclared defaults. Absent classes remain explicitly unsupported; never merge/relabel them or resample test cases.
future_search_budget: At most 4 prespecified configurations per algorithm/domain; write and hash search spaces before fitting
hyperparameter_selection: Lowest training CV MAE; ties by highest macro F1 then simpler configuration
validation_selection: Choose one algorithm per domain by lowest validation MAE; ties by macro F1 then fixed order RF, SVM, XGB, CatBoost. No validation-driven search expansion.
finalization: Freeze selected model files, feature schemas, split/config/code hashes and selection log before opening test predictions; no refit after validation selection
test_policy: One final evaluation of frozen candidates and selected four-domain system; no post-test tuning or generator changes
missing_class_reporting: Always show support for all 5 labels and distinguish unsupported classes from measured zero performance
baseline: Unchanged PP1 engine on the same raw CSVs. It defines the targets: agreement is a deterministic consistency baseline, not learned or clinical performance.
stress_test: Separate optional 40-session chirp_interference_shift generation, config frozen now. Evaluate only after final model freeze; never use stress results to tune this benchmark.
null_policy: Do not invent missing targets or MPS. Report null counts; only valid targets enter domain fitting and only complete sessions enter MPS metrics. Use the same eligibility mask across algorithms.
